personality_one_liner: A highly functional, precision-focused utility that pairs stark backgrounds with perfectly rounded, tactile buttons and a signature orange accent.

spacing.rule: Generous padding for tool cards and tight, exact grids for the calculator buttons. Use md or lg gaps between standard layout components.

do's: Use subtle glass over scrolling calculation history.
Use glass on bottom tab bar to feel floating.
dont's: No glass on the calculator buttons themselves.
Do not blur standard tool cards.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A dashboard indexing Favorites, Recently Used tools, and Global Search.

states.empty: No favorites yet? Tap the star icon on any tool to pin it here.

screens.layout: Sticky search bar at top. 'Favorites' horizontal scrolling or grid. 'Recently Used' section below. Use surfaceSecondary cards with lg radius. Tinted icons inside brandTertiary rounded squares for each tool card.

screens.name: Calculator
screens.purpose: Primary standard and scientific calculation interface.

states.error: Error in calculation displayed in the result display area.

screens.layout: Top half is a massive display (flex-grow) showing current equation and result, using Space Grotesk. Bottom half is a tightly spaced grid (gap: md). Numeric buttons use surfaceSecondary (pill or lg radius). Operator buttons use brandTertiary (light orange) with onBrandTertiary text. Equals button uses brandPrimary (solid orange).

screens.name: Finance
screens.purpose: List/Grid of finance tools (GST, Currency, SIP, EMI).

states.error: Failed to load exchange rates for Currency Converter.

screens.layout: Grid of surfaceSecondary cards. Each card has a leading brandTertiary tinted icon. Clicking opens a sub-screen. For sub-screens, forms are single-column with lg spacing and a sticky calculate CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Converters
screens.purpose: List of unit converters (Age, BMI, Length, Mass, etc.).
screens.layout: A 2-column grid layout of cards. Each has an icon and text. Clean and readable. Use Ionicons filled for tools.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the user's specific request for a 'MIUI-inspired' look. This means perfectly rounded keys (lg or pill) for the calculator, a distinct orange accent (#FF6A00), and crisp high-contrast cards.
Use 'Space Grotesk' exclusively for the massive numbers in the calculator display to ensure monospaced, highly readable math logic.
Calculator Key Coloring: Numbers = surfaceSecondary. Clear/Secondary actions = surfaceTertiary. Math Operators (+, -, x, /) = brandTertiary. Equals (=) = brandPrimary.
Finance and Converter screens should use 2-column or list layouts. Every tool must have an icon enclosed in a brandTertiary tinted background square.
Bottom Tab Navigation must feel floating and minimal. Use glassmorphism on the tab bar if possible.
Enable touch haptics rigorously on calculator buttons—this is a utility app, physical response makes it feel premium.
The exception to the 'no orange' rule was applied here explicitly because the prompt mandates 'Signature MIUI orange accent color'. Do not change it to dark-gray.
